description: MCP arguments and structuredContent schemas. REST envelopes are unwrapped; lists retain data and optional pagination meta. Optional fields depend on resource state. Examples use synthetic contacts.

tools.name: assinafy_list_documents
tools.description: Search workspace documents by name or status, with pagination. Use it to find a document the user names before inspecting or following up on it.

search.description: partial match on document name or signer

sort.description: name or updated_at; prefix with - for descending

method.description: signature method filter: virtual or collect

tags.description: comma-separated tag IDs; documents must have all listed tags

account_id.description: account ID; uses request routing if omitted

tools.name: assinafy_get_document
tools.description: Inspect one known document: status, assignment, signers with their progress, pages and available artifacts. Read it before retrying a send or following up. 100% signed does not mean certification is finished; the signed PDF is ready at status certificated.

tools.name: assinafy_list_document_activities
tools.description: List the activities recorded for a document. Each entry carries an event-specific `payload` snapshot (keys vary per event) and the request `origin` (`ip`, `user-agent`). Use it to explain what happened to a document and when.

tools.name: assinafy_list_whatsapp_notifications
tools.description: List all WhatsApp notification messages sent for an assignment. The response includes the rendered template text split into `header`, `body` and `buttons` — exactly what the signer would see. In sandbox/stage, WhatsApp messages are simulated (no real delivery) and button URLs include access/verification codes you can use to simulate the signing flow. Treat returned signing links and verification codes as sensitive; never use them to sign for another person. Use it to troubleshoot WhatsApp delivery for one assignment.

tools.name: assinafy_upload_document
tools.description: Upload a PDF without sending invitations and return its document ID. Use it when the user wants to prepare a document now and send it later with assinafy_create_assignment. Never upload again when a document ID is already known.

file_base64.description: base64 PDF bytes, at most 25 MiB decoded

account_id.description: authorized workspace; discovered through OAuth when omitted

tools.name: assinafy_rename_document
tools.description: Update a document's name. Only allowed before any assignment is created (i.e. while the document is in `uploaded` or `metadata_ready` status and has no signers yet); once the signature process has started or the document is certificated, the name is locked. The name is normalized: diacritics are removed and unsupported characters are replaced with dashes.

tools.name: assinafy_send_pdf_for_signature
tools.description: Upload a new PDF, wait for processing and invite signers by full name and email, using Email verification and notification. This sends invitations and uses plan allowance: use only recipients the user authorized. After a partial failure, inspect the retained document ID and continue with assinafy_create_assignment instead of uploading again.

account_id.description: account ID; uses the request or server default if omitted

email.description: signer's email address; existing exact matches are reused

signers.description: one or more signers to create or reuse and request signatures from

expires_at.description: assignment expiry timestamp in RFC 3339 format

max_wait_secs.description: maximum seconds to wait for PDF processing (default 30; max 600)

poll_secs.description: polling interval in seconds (default 2; cannot exceed max_wait_secs)

estimate_only.description: upload and prepare the PDF, then return cost and document ID without creating contacts or sending invitations; reuse that ID to send

tools.name: assinafy_create_assignment
tools.description:
Request signatures on a document. Use `method: virtual` to sign without input fields, or `method: collect` to place input fields on specific pages. DigitalCertificate signers require `method: virtual`; other methods fail with code `digital_certificate_requires_virtual`.

For **virtual**, the document may be in `uploaded`, `metadata_processing` or `metadata_ready`; it is promoted to `pending_signature` automatically once metadata processing completes. For **collect**, the document must be in `metadata_ready` (fields reference specific pages).

`step` controls signing order: signers sharing a step sign in parallel, and the next step is notified only after the previous step completes. If supplied, every signer must supply it and values must be contiguous starting at 1. Obtain signer IDs from assinafy_list_signers or assinafy_create_signer and page IDs from assinafy_get_document. This sends signing invitations. Check with assinafy_get_document that no assignment exists first; this can consume credits.

copy_receivers.description: Signer IDs that only receive a copy.

fontSize.description: Font size in the 150-DPI page-image coordinate system.

height.description: Height of the placement rectangle, in page-image pixels.

left.description: Horizontal distance from the page's left edge, in page-image pixels.

top.description: Vertical distance from the page's top edge, in page-image pixels.

width.description: Width of the placement rectangle, in page-image pixels.

display_settings.description: A field placement rectangle on a document page. Geometry values are pixels in Assinafy's 150-DPI page image, measured from the upper-left corner. Clients must keep the rectangle within the selected page's width and height; the API does not clamp out-of-bounds values.

entries.description: Required for `collect`: field placements per page.

estimate_only.description: Preview cost and balances without creating an assignment or notifying anyone.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601; default is no expiration. Must be at least one hour in the future.

message.description: Text included in the invitation email.

notification_methods.description: How the signer is told a signature is being requested. **Exactly one method per signer** — the array shape is historical, and sending two returns `400`. The method must also be compatible with `verification_method`: `Email` verification takes `Email`, `Whatsapp` verification takes `Whatsapp`, and `DigitalCertificate` and `IdDocumentFaceMatchBasic` take either. WhatsApp incurs an additional cost and is available only on paid subscriptions. Omit it to have it inferred from `verification_method`, or `{"Email"}` when neither is sent. See **Verification & Notification Methods** for the full pairing table.

verification_method.description: How the signer's identity is verified before signing. `Email` (default) sends a one-time code to the signer's email; `Whatsapp` sends the code over WhatsApp — the verification itself is not billed, but it requires the WhatsApp notification channel, so the signer costs 0.45 credits (available only on paid subscriptions); `DigitalCertificate` has the signer sign with their own ICP-Brasil certificate (A1/A3) — it requires `method: virtual`, the Digital Certificate feature, a CPF or CNPJ in `government_id`, must be alone in its signing step, and is charged 0.5 credits per signer. A CPF requires that person's certificate (an e-CPF, or an e-CNPJ naming them as legal representative); a CNPJ requires an e-CNPJ for that company, from any of its representatives. `IdDocumentFaceMatchBasic` verifies the signer from a photo of their government ID, a photo of them holding it and a liveness check — it requires the ID Document + Face Match feature, the signer must have a valid CPF in `government_id`, and is charged a per-signer fee. Omit to default to `Email`.

tools.name: assinafy_create_document_from_template
tools.description: Generate a document from a saved template and invite one signer per role, by signer ID or full name and email. Find roles with assinafy_list_templates and validate editor_fields values with assinafy_validate_fields first. DigitalCertificate signers require a virtual template without placed fields. This sends invitations and can consume credits.

id.description: existing signer ID; use instead of full_name and email

full_name.description: signer's full name; required when id is omitted

email.description: signer's email address, required when id is omitted; existing exact matches are reused

verification_method.description: Email (default), Whatsapp, DigitalCertificate (A1/A3, virtual templates without placed fields only), or IdDocumentFaceMatchBasic (ID photo and liveness)

notification_methods.description: at most one channel: Email or Whatsapp; inferred from verification_method when omitted

step.description: signing order, contiguous from 1; all signers must set it if any does

signers.description: one signer per template role, each by ID or by name and email

value.description: value to bake into the generated document

tags.description: tag names, merged with the template's defaults

account_id.description: account ID; uses request routing if omitted

estimate_only.description: preview cost and balances for the given roles without creating contacts, documents or invitations; roles alone are sufficient

tools.name: assinafy_resend_notification
tools.description: Send one reminder to a pending signer in the assignment's active step, after confirming with assinafy_get_document that they have not signed. May consume notification credits; never repeat a reminder only because progress is unchanged.

estimate_only.description: preview the reminder cost and balances without notifying the signer

tools.name: assinafy_update_signer
tools.description:
Update a signer's information.

**Verification integrity:** `email` / `whatsapp_phone_number` cannot be changed while the signer has verified that channel on an in-flight (not yet certificated) document — the response is `400` naming the offending document(s). tools.name: assinafy_update_contract
tools.description: Manage an existing document’s CLM record: set creates/patches terms or links a signed amendment; renew starts the next term; terminate closes tracking. Requires a tracking plan. Read first: include terms.updated_at for existing terms or links; renew requires the current term and updated_at, terminate requires updated_at. A conflict needs a fresh read and user review, never blind retries. Only supplied terms change; external_references replaces the list; null can clear values or unlink a pending amendment. Assinafy owns auto-renewal and owner reminders; changes can trigger lifecycle emails/webhooks. These actions do not sign, send or cancel the document itself. Use only for changes the user authorized.

end_date.description: The new end date, after the current one. Absent, empty or `null`: the current end date plus the renewal term, stepped until it is in the future; `term` is then required.

reason.description: Kept in the `document_contract_terminated` event; HTML is stripped.

term.description: The term this renewal starts from, the contract's current `term`. Required unless `end_date` is sent; for a contract in another term the renewal is refused, so a repeated request never renews twice.

auto_renew.description: Whether the hourly run starts the next term the day after `end_date`, by `renewal_term_months`, instead of expiring the contract.

counterparty_name.description: Emoji are kept; other characters outside the 3-byte range are dropped.

counterparty_taxpayer_id.description: A valid CPF or CNPJ, formatted or not.

currency.description: Three letters, such as `BRL` or `USD`, stored in capitals; `BRL` when a `value` is set without one.

id.description: Kept as sent; must not contain emoji or other 4-byte characters.

system.description: Letters, digits, `_`, `-` and `.`; stored in lower case.

external_references.description: Replaces the whole list; `[]` or `null` clears it. Two items whose `system` and `id` compare equal case aside are one reference (the first sent is kept); a pair the database takes for one beyond that (accents, `ß` and `ss`) answers `400`.

metadata.description: Your own fields: up to 50 keys of 1 to 40 letters, digits, `_`, `-` or `.`, each holding plain text of at most 500 characters; no number under a key ending in `_at`, or `stuck_since`.

notice_period_days.description: Days before `end_date` the notice period starts (`document_contract_renewal_notice`); none when unset.

owner_id.description: An active member of this workspace.

parent_document_id.description: Links the document as an amendment of this contract document, or of any document in its family (resolved to the root); `null` unlinks a pending amendment. With it, the other attributes are the terms the instrument changes, not terms of its own; on a pending amendment a `null` value drops that term from the delta rather than clearing it on the parent.

relation_type.description: Required on the first link. `amendment` may change `value`, `currency`, `start_date` (effective from, display only), `end_date`, `auto_renew`, `renewal_term_months`, `notice_period_days`, `counterparty_name`, `counterparty_taxpayer_id` and `metadata`; `renewal` only `end_date` and `value`; `termination` only `end_date` (the effective date).

counterparty_name.description: Emoji are kept; other characters outside the 3-byte range are dropped.

counterparty_taxpayer_id.description: A valid CPF or CNPJ, formatted or not.

currency.description: Three letters, such as `BRL` or `USD`, stored in capitals; `BRL` when a `value` is set without one.

system.description: Letters, digits, `_`, `-` and `.`; stored in lower case.

notice_period_days.description: Days before `end_date` the notice period starts (`document_contract_renewal_notice`); none when unset.

owner_id.description: An active member of this workspace.

Assignment.description: A request for signers to sign a document.

field.description: Field definition associated with the item.

display_settings.description: Rendering metadata for the item. Collect items use the DisplaySettings schema; virtual and legacy items may return an empty or non-object value.

value.description: Captured value when completed; `null` until then.

AssignmentSigner.description: A signer within an assignment: the base Signer plus per-assignment verification/notification details.

identity_verification_status.description: Latest identity-document verification status; `InReview` means the account must decide it before the document can be certificated.

notification_history.description: Per-channel delivery history for this signer (email + WhatsApp), most-recent send order.

CostEstimate.description: Cost breakdown for an assignment plus current account balances.

needs_extra_document.description: True when the plan's document allowance is exhausted and an extra document will be charged from credits.

extra_document_cost.description: Credits charged for the extra document when `needs_extra_document` is true.

Document.description: A document and its current lifecycle state.

assignment.description: Expanded assignment data when included via ?expand=assignment; null otherwise.

DocumentVerification.description: The verification result for a document looked up by signature hash. When not verified, most fields are null and `is_valid` is false.

agreement_code.description: Agreement code printed on the document certificate.

FieldValidationResult.description: A per-field result from a multi-field validation.

NotificationHistoryEntry.description: A single notification delivery record for a signer channel.

Signer.description: A signing party belonging to a workspace account.

government_id.description: Signer's normalized CPF (11 digits) or CNPJ (14 characters; may be alphanumeric).

document_name.description: Default name for documents created from this template.

status.description: One of uploading, uploaded, processing, ready, failed.

default_document_tags.description: Applied to documents created from this template; only returned by the single-template endpoint.

WhatsappNotification.description: A rendered WhatsApp notification sent for an assignment, split into header/body/buttons as the signer would see them.

text.description: The button label shown to the signer.

DocumentContract.description: The contract terms tracked on a document.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code; `BRL` when a value is sent without one.

term.description: Steps on every renewal, starting at 1.

owner_id.description: ID of the workspace member who owns the contract. When the owner is no longer a member of the workspace (removed, left, or deleted with their account), the hourly run hands the contract to the first owner who is still an active member, or leaves it without one; an inactive member stays the owner. The contract's e-mails (renewal notice, expiring, expired, renewed) go to the first of the owner and the document's creator who is an active member, as that member's notification preferences allow.

metadata.description: Up to 50 keys of your own, each holding text of at most 500 characters; `null` when there are none. A key ending in `_at` cannot hold a number: the API returns numbers under such keys as dates.

external_references.description: IDs outside systems use for this contract, ordered by system and id.

document.description: Only with `expand=document`: the document the terms are tracked on.

amendments.description: Only on the single-contract read: the documents that amend, renew or terminate this contract, the applied ones first by `number`, then the pending ones.

DocumentContractAmendment.description: A document that amends, renews or terminates a contract: its link and the terms it changes. The parent's terms take the delta once this document is certificated; until then the parent is untouched.

parent_document_id.description: The contract document whose terms change.

number.description: Position among the parent's applied amendments by signing date; `null` while pending.

status.description: `applied` once the delta moved the parent's terms.

document_status.description: This document's own status, so a declined, cancelled or expired instrument shows as such. An instrument applies only while its document is `certificated`: one whose document reads `failed` after it was signed waits, with no `apply_error`, until it is certificated again, and then applies in its place in the signing order.

apply_error.description: Why a signed instrument has not applied yet, retried every hour: the workspace's plan does not include contract tracking (it applies on the first run after the plan returns), the parent would not take the delta, an instrument signed before this one has not applied yet, one signed after it has already applied (this one then stays blocked: unlink it, and record what it still changes on a new instrument), or an unexpected failure.

currency.description: The currency of the amounts in `terms` and `changes`. Once applied, the contract's currency at that moment, kept whatever the contract moves to later. While pending (and for an instrument applied before this was kept), the one this instrument moves the contract to, otherwise the contract's. `null` when neither has one.

terms.description: The delta: only the terms this instrument changes; `null` when it changes none (a termination on the day it is signed).

changes.description: Every parent field the roll-up moves, as `{from, to}`: a preview while pending, the record once applied; `null` when it moves none.
